SELECT 
  s.City, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS NumberOfCities, 
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS NumberOfSchools
FROM 
  schools s
  JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE 
  s.GSoffered = 'K-8' AND 
  s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND 
  f.NSLPProvisionStatus = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY 
  s.City
ORDER BY 
  NumberOfCities DESC

SELECT T1.SchoolName, T1.MailStreet, T1.MailCity, T1.MailZip
FROM schools AS T1
JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.enrollment12 > 800 AND T1.MailCity = 'Monterey' AND T1.MailZip IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 52 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0) / 
  (COUNT(CASE WHEN DOC = 54 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100.0) AS Ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange County'

SELECT 
  scc.CountyName, 
  COUNT(scc.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM 
  schools s
  JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
  JOIN scc ON s.CDSCode = scc.CDSCode
WHERE 
  scc.CountyName IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND 
  scc.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY 
  scc.CountyName
ORDER BY 
  num_schools DESC

SELECT 
  `County Code`, 
  `District Code` 
FROM 
  schools 
WHERE 
  `AdmFName1` = 'Alusine' 
  AND `AdmEmail1` = 'alusine@acoe.org' 
  AND `Street` = '313 West Winton Avenue'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS T1 
WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' 
AND T1.MathScore > 400 
AND T1.EducationalOptionType = 'Virtual' 
AND T1.Latitude IS NOT NULL 
AND T1.Longitude IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SchoolName 
FROM schools AS T1 
JOIN satscores AS T2 
ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T1.Virtual = 'F' 
ORDER BY AVG(T2.AvgScrRead) DESC 
LIMIT 5

SELECT T1.artist 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.flavorText 
WHERE T2.flavorText LIKE '%Jeremy Jarvis%' 
  OR T2.flavorText LIKE '%Aaron Miller%' 
  OR T2.flavorText LIKE '%Chippy%'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN power IS NULL OR power = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(power IS NULL OR power = '*') AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE power IS NULL OR power = '*'
AND language = 'French'

SELECT 
  c.id, 
  c.artist
FROM 
  cards c
WHERE 
  c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*' 
  AND c.format = 'commander' 
  AND c.status = 'Legal'

SELECT T1.id, T1.rarity, T1.format 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.rarity = 'Mythic' AND T1.format = 'Gladiator'

SELECT 
  s.name AS set_name,
  s.type AS set_type,
  s.type AS set_type_korean
FROM 
  sets s
  INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.id = st.setCode
  INNER JOIN foreign_data fd ON st.id = fd.uuid
WHERE 
  fd.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
  AND st.language = 'Korean'
SELECT flavorText FROM cards WHERE name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

SELECT 
  l.status 
FROM 
  legalities 
  INNER JOIN sets s ON legalities.uuid = sets.uuid 
  INNER JOIN cards c ON sets.uuid = cards.uuid 
WHERE 
  c.type = 'Artifact' 
  AND c.side IS NULL 
  AND s.baseSetSize > 0 
  AND s.releaseDate IS NOT NULL 
  AND s.type = 'vintage'

SELECT 
  id,
  CASE 
    WHEN isTextless = 0 THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END AS textless,
  COUNT(id) AS count
FROM 
  cards
WHERE 
  isStorylight = 1 AND isTextless = 0
GROUP BY 
  id
ORDER BY 
  id

SELECT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.setCode 
WHERE T2.translation = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

SELECT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.setCode 
WHERE T2.language = 'Italian' 
AND T1.convertManaCost = ( SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) 
                         FROM cards AS T3 
                         JOIN set_translations AS T4 ON T3.setCode = T4.setCode 
                         WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' )

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN convertedManaCost = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(convertedManaCost) AS percentage
FROM cards
WHERE name = 'Coldsnap'

SELECT T1.name, T1.format, T1.banned
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
JOIN sets AS T3 ON T2.uuid = T3.uuid
JOIN sets AS T4 ON T3.id = T4.id
JOIN sets AS T5 ON T4.id = T5.id
WHERE T3.type = 'Commander' AND T4.type = 'EDHRec' AND T1.edhrecRank = 1
SELECT format FROM legalities WHERE uuid = '5f8287b1-5bb6-5f4c-ad17-316a40'

SELECT T1.borderless, T1.cardKingdomId
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE T1.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
AND T1.cardKingdomId NOT IN (
  SELECT T2.cardKingdomId
  FROM cards AS T2
  JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T2.cardKingdomId = T3.cardKingdomId
  WHERE T3.isFoil = 0 AND T3.isPromo = 0
)
AND T1.cardKingdomId NOT IN (
  SELECT T2.cardKingdomId
  FROM cards AS T2
  JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T2.cardKingdomId = T3.cardKingdomId
  WHERE T3.isFoil = 1 AND T3.isPromo = 0
)
SELECT id FROM cards WHERE duelDeck = 'a'

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.id 
WHERE T2.status = 'Banned' AND T1.borderColor = 'white'

SELECT T1.Title, T1.ViewCount
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' OR T2.DisplayName = 'Noah Snyder'
ORDER BY T1.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Score > 50 AND Reputation > 100 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Score > 50 THEN 1 END) AS percentage
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users))

SELECT 
  p.Title, 
  p.Comment, 
  AVG(p.ViewCount) AS AverageViewCount
FROM 
  posts p
  JOIN posts_tags pt ON p.Id = pt.PostId
  JOIN tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id
WHERE 
  t.TagName = '<humor>'
GROUP BY 
  p.Title, 
  p.Comment
ORDER BY 
  AverageViewCount DESC

SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ParentId WHERE T1.Title = 'Open source tools for visualizing multi-dimensional data' AND T1.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'user28')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Reputation > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Id) AS percentage
FROM users
WHERE CreationDate LIKE '%2011%' AND Reputation > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT u.UserId 
FROM users u 
JOIN postHistory ph ON u.Id = ph.UserId 
WHERE ph.PostId IN (SELECT Id FROM posts WHERE Views > 1000) 
AND u.UserId IN (SELECT UserId FROM postHistory GROUP BY UserId HAVING COUNT(*) = 1)
SELECT T1.Id FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.DisplayName = 'slashnick' ORDER BY T2.RevisionGUID DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT u.DisplayName, u.LastAccessDate, u Views 
FROM users u 
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId 
WHERE p.Title = 'Computer Game Datasets' 
ORDER BY u.LastAccessDate DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  CAST(COUNT(CreationDate) AS REAL) / 
  CAST(COUNT(CreationDate) - 1 AS REAL) AS vote_ratio
FROM votes
WHERE YEAR(CreationDate) = 2010 OR YEAR(CreationDate) = 2011

SELECT AVG(Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'csgillespie')
SELECT EXcerptPostId, WikiPostId FROM tags WHERE TagName = 'sample'
SELECT COUNT(T1.Id) AS num_posts FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id WHERE T2.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini'

SELECT Id, Title 
FROM posts 
WHERE DisplayName = 'Harvey Motulsky' 
ORDER BY ViewCount DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.UserId) 
FROM badges AS T1 
JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id 
WHERE T1.Name > 5
SELECT T2.Text FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN comments AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId ORDER BY T1.Score DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  COALESCE(YEARmonth.Date, '2012-01-01') AS Date,
  COALESCE(YEARmonth.Consumption, 0) AS Consumption_2012,
  COALESCE(YEARmonth.Consumption, 0) - COALESCE(YEARmonth.Consumption, 0) AS Consumption_2013,
  COALESCE(YEARmonth.Consumption, 0) - COALESCE(YEARmonth.Consumption, 0) / COALESCE(YEARmonth.Date, '2012-01-01') AS Consumption Decrease Rate
FROM 
  transactions_1k t1
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON t1.Date = ym.Date
  JOIN customers c ON t1.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
  t1.TransactionID = 6348
  AND ym.Date = '2012/08/25'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' AND Price > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN 1 END) AS Percentage
FROM transactions_1k

SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Date, T1.Consumption
FROM yearmonth T1
JOIN transactions_1k T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
JOIN products T3 ON T2.ProductID = T3.ProductID
WHERE T3.Description = 'Rucní zadání' AND T3.Price = 29.00 AND T2.Date LIKE '201208%'

SELECT T2.Date, T2.Consumption
FROM customers AS T1
JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'SME'
AND T2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
AND T1.Currency = 'EUR'
ORDER BY T2.Date DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS more_discount_gas_stations
FROM gasstations

SELECT SUM(T2.Amount) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth AS T1
JOIN transactions_1k AS T2
ON T1.Date = T2.Date AND T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'
AND T1.CustomerID = 6

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN CustomerID ELSE NULL END) AS EUR,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN CustomerID ELSE NULL END) AS CZK
FROM customers

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(CASE WHEN Segment = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) * 100 AS Percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK'

SELECT AVG(overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE player_api_id = 'Marko Arnautovic' 
AND date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT T1.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T1
JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.home_team_api_id AND T1.team_api_id = T2.away_team_api_id
WHERE T2.season = '2009/2010'
AND T2.match_api_id = (
  SELECT MAX(T3.match_api_id)
  FROM Match AS T3
  JOIN Team AS T4 ON T3.home_team_api_id = T4.team_api_id AND T3.away_team_api_id = T4.team_api_id
  WHERE T3.season = '2009/2010'
  GROUP BY T4.team_api_id
  HAVING COUNT(T3.match_api_id) = 1
)

SELECT 
  player_api_id 
FROM 
  Player_Attributes 
WHERE 
  player_api_id, 
  date IN (
    SELECT 
      player_api_id, 
      date 
    FROM 
      Player_Attributes 
    WHERE 
      (YEAR(date) = '2013' AND 
       YEAR(date) = '2014' AND 
       YEAR(date) = '2015') 
      AND 
      sprint_speed > = 97
  )

SELECT 
  MAX(AVG(finishing)) AS highest_average_finishing_rate,
  MAX(height) AS highest_football_player,
  MIN(height) AS shortest_football_player
FROM 
  Player_Attributes
WHERE 
  height > (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT T1.name FROM League AS T1 INNER JOIN Match AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.league_id WHERE T2.season = '2015/2016' AND T2.goal = ( SELECT MAX(T2.goal) FROM Match AS T3 WHERE T3.season = '2015/2016' )

SELECT T2.player_name 
FROM Player_Attributes T1 
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id 
WHERE T1.overall_rating > 70 AND T1.dribbling > 70

SELECT T1.name AS league_name, COUNT(T1.id) AS total_matches
FROM League AS T1
JOIN (
  SELECT league_id, COUNT(*) AS total_matches
  FROM Match
  GROUP BY league_id
) AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.league_id
GROUP BY T1.name
ORDER BY total_matches DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes T1
JOIN Team T2 ON T1.team_fifa_api_id = T2.team_fifa_api_id
WHERE T1.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT T1.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes AS T1
JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND T1.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'

SELECT defenceAggressionClass 
FROM Team_Attributes 
WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Hannover 96') 
AND date LIKE '2015-09-10'
SELECT name FROM League WHERE SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = (SELECT MAX(SUM(home_team_goal, away_team_goal)) FROM Match WHERE season = '2015/2016')
error: wrong number of arguments to function SUM()

SELECT MAX(crossing) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
AND crossing > (SELECT MAX(crossing) 
               FROM Player_Attributes 
               WHERE preferred_foot = 'left')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' 
AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT T2.player_name FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.height DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T2.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT T1.player_api_id, T1.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes T1
JOIN Player T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.overall_rating = ( SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes )

SELECT T1.type, AVG(T2.A11) AS average_income
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.client_id
WHERE T1.type != 'OWNER'
AND T2.district_id IN (
  SELECT A8
  FROM district AS T3
  WHERE T3.A6 = '0'
  AND T3.A7 = '0'
)
GROUP BY T1.type

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T2.birth_date DESC
UNION
SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account AS T1
JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE T2.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY T2.birth_date ASC
LIMIT 1
error: ORDER BY clause should come after UNION not before

SELECT T1.district_name, T1.amount
FROM trans AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.disp_id = T2.disp_id
JOIN account AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE T1.type = 'VYDAJ'
AND T1.date LIKE '1996-01%'
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(T1.client_id) AS male_count
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id
JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.disp_id = T4.disp_id
JOIN district AS T5 ON T4.client_id = T5.client_id
JOIN loan AS T6 ON T1.account_id = T6.account_id
JOIN loan AS T7 ON T1.account_id = T7.account_id
JOIN account AS T8 ON T1.account_id = T8.account_id
JOIN client AS T9 ON T8.client_id = T9.client_id
JOIN disp AS T10 ON T7.disp_id = T10.disp_id
JOIN district AS T11 ON T10.client_id = T11.client_id
WHERE T1.status = 'A'
AND T5.A15 = (SELECT MAX(A15) FROM loan AS T12 WHERE T12.account_id = T1.account_id AND T12.date LIKE '%/%/1995')
AND T3.gender = 'M'
ORDER BY T5.A15 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(loan_id) 
FROM loan 
WHERE date >= '1995-01-01' AND date <= '1997-12-31' 
AND frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' 
AND amount >= 250000

SELECT AVG(A15) AS average_crimes
FROM loan
WHERE A13 > 4000 AND A3 = 'prague' AND A15 > 0 AND A15 > 1997 AND A11 > 0

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN T1.client_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.client_id) AS percentage
FROM client AS T1
JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
WHERE T2.type = 'USER' AND T2.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE') AND T1.gender = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
WHERE status = 'C' AND district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A1 = '1')

SELECT client_id, birth_date, age
FROM client
WHERE type = 'gold' AND disp.type = 'OWNER' AND age > 18

SELECT CAST((SELECT T2.champion_time - T1.driver_time FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.year = 2008 AND T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND T2.driverId = 1) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT driver_time FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T1.year = 2008 AND T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix') AS percentage

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN year(dob) < 1985 AND laps > 50 THEN driverId ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DriverID) AS percentage
FROM drivers
WHERE year(dob) < 1985
AND laps > 50

SELECT AVG(CAST(r.time AS REAL)) AS average_time
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
JOIN drivers c ON s.year = c.year AND r.driverId = c.driverId
WHERE r.status = 'Finished' AND r.position = 1 AND r.time IS NOT NULL AND r.year < 1975
GROUP BY s.year

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN qualifying AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE T3.q3 = (SELECT MIN(q3) FROM qualifying WHERE q3 IN ('q1', 'q2', 'q3')) AND T2.year = 2008 AND T2.circuitId = (SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit')

SELECT T1.name, T1.year
FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
JOIN lapTimes AS T4 ON T2.resultId = T4.resultId
JOIN status AS T5 ON T4.statusId = T5.statusId
JOIN drivers AS T6 ON T4.driverId = T6.driverId
JOIN constructors AS T7 ON T6.constructorId = T7.constructorId
JOIN circuits AS T8 ON T7.circuitId = T8.circuitId
WHERE T6.forename = 'Michael' AND T6.surname = 'Schumacher' AND T4.position = 1 AND T4.positionText = '1' AND T5.statusId = 1

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.country = 'Germany' AND T2.name = 'European Grand Prix' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.name) AS percentage
FROM races AS T1
JOIN seasons AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year
WHERE T1.name = 'European Grand Prix'

SELECT COUNT(driverId) 
FROM drivers 
WHERE number = 14 AND time < '02:00:00' AND nationality = 'French'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM drivers d 
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId 
JOIN races pr ON r.raceId = pr.raceId 
JOIN seasons s ON pr.year = s.year 
JOIN constructors c ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId 
WHERE r.statusId = 3 AND s.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND d.dob = '1985-06-07'

SELECT name 
FROM races 
WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(year) FROM seasons) 
AND month = (SELECT MIN(month) FROM seasons)

SELECT D2.nationality
FROM results R
JOIN drivers D1 ON R.driverId = D1.driverId
JOIN constructors C ON D1.constructorId = C.constructorId
JOIN status S ON R.statusId = S.statusId
JOIN drivers D2 ON R.driverId = D2.driverId
JOIN drivers D3 ON R.driverId = D3.driverId
JOIN drivers D4 ON R.driverId = D4.driverId
JOIN drivers D5 ON R.driverId = D5.driverId
JOIN drivers D6 ON R.driverId = D6.driverId
JOIN drivers D7 ON R.driverId = D7.driverId
